name: App. BiL + Price Change on Return (before QP)
subGroup: Return from a Break In Learning
description: Creates a 2-year apprenticeship (2025-08-01 to 2027-07-31, £20,000). One year in — having earned half the on-programme payments (less the completion) — the learner goes on a break in learning (pause 2026-07-31, resume 2026-11-01). On return, the price is changed to £5,000. The learner completes 7 days after resuming (2026-11-08), which is below the 42-day qualifying period — post-break earnings should not be generated.

steps.name: SLD Submits Break In Learning, Price Change, and Completion
